name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – Before § 1 – Am 18
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 1e. Stresses that it is the promotion of peace, cooperation and compliance with the principles of the UN Charter and the Helsinki Final Act that serves the interests of the peoples of Europe, and not the promotion of militarism, arms escalation and war;
